test_title: PYST 4: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 26 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when placed from left to right in the blanks, will complete the letter series.

_ P N I E X _ N I E Y P N _ E Z P _ I _
solution:
The logic followed here is:

A particular pattern is observed after every five letters and after every fourth letter the sixth letter is the succeeding letter of the first one.

Option 1) I E W P N

**I **P N I E / X **E **N I E / Y P N **W **E / Z P **P **I **N**

No pattern is seen here.

Option 2) N I E W P

**N **P N I E / X **I **N I E / Y P N **E **E / Z P **W **I **P**

No pattern is seen here.

**Option** **3) W P I N E**

***__W __***P N I E / ***__X __***P N I E / **__*Y *__**P N **I **E/ **__*Z *__**P **N **I **E**

**Thus, this option is correct. **

Option 4) E W P N I

**E** P N I E / X **W **N E / Y P N **P **E / Z P **N **I **I**

No pattern is seen here

Hence, **W P I N E** is the correct answer.
